envelope.description: Add the additive DaemonStatus.installedCommit field + wire the daemon.status handler

body.title: Add the additive DaemonStatus.installedCommit field + wire the daemon.status handler
body.summary: Add installedCommit:string to the DaemonStatus interface (src/shared/types.ts, at the existing DaemonStatus — unshifted by S001) and set it in the daemon.status handler by calling readInstalledCommit(). Locate the handler BY NAME (the 'daemon.status': async () => {...} entry carrying the 'best-effort; status should never throw' fs-stat catch, now ~src/daemon/index.ts:944 after S001's line drift), NOT the stale :922 anchor. The handler needs no new try/catch — readInstalledCommit itself never throws — so daemon.status's never-throw guarantee is preserved. Additive only: no other field changes, sc1 (daemon.update/updateOutcome) untouched.
acceptanceChecks: src/shared/types.ts DaemonStatus carries a required installedCommit:string field
the daemon.status handler sets installedCommit from readInstalledCommit() and returns it on the status object
a reader returning '' yields installedCommit:'' with the rest of the status intact (handler never throws)
no other DaemonStatus field changed; daemon.update/updateOutcome (sc1) untouched

tests.name: daemon.status status object includes installedCommit populated from the (injected/stub) reader
daemon.status with a reader returning '' yields installedCommit:'' with the rest of the status intact and never throws
daemon.status change leaves sc1 fields (daemon.update/updateOutcome) untouched
